title: Independent Holdout Results and Report Consistency Audit

checks.name: Recompute Holdout Summary Statistics
checks.details: All holdout summary statistics (mean, SD, median, 95% CI) recomputed from per_tile_holdout_metrics.csv match summary.json to within 1e-6.

checks.name: Investigate Development Win/Loss Discrepancy
checks.details: Development data from per_tile_oof_metrics.csv has 96 wins and 11 losses (89.72%), matching EXP-016 exactly. The 83/24 (77.57%) reported in EXP-017 Section 5 was a hardcoded transcription error in run_holdout_evaluation.py. Correcting this erratum strengthens the replication findings (dev win rate 89.72% vs holdout win rate 86.92%).

checks.name: Reconcile Development Statistics Across Reports
checks.details: EXP-015/EXP-016 ground truth: Hybrid mean=0.304210, Sobel mean=0.222005, delta=+0.082205. EXP-017 comparison table reported 0.30476, 0.22241, +0.08235. The discrepancies are minor (+0.00055 in rho, +0.00014 in delta) due to manual transcription in run_holdout_evaluation.py rather than dynamic loading. Both used identical tiles (107 dev tiles), compensated error, and standard tie handling.

checks.name: Hybrid vs Input Sensitivity Plausibility
checks.details: Both p-values recomputed exactly: t-test p=0.174703 (t=1.3664), Wilcoxon p=0.000587 (W=1783.0). The difference is mathematically sound and caused by severe negative skewness (skew=-4.64, kurtosis=36.15) and an extreme negative outlier (min=-0.2691 on tile 32822_54029). While 71/107 tiles (66.36%) favor Hybrid, inflating the non-parametric Wilcoxon rank sum, the outlier inflates s_diff to 0.03436 and reduces the t-statistic.

checks.name: Verify Sparsification & AURG Definitions
checks.details: 20-point uniform integration on p in [0.0, 0.95] verified. 20% sparsification MAE reduction: Hybrid=11.27% vs Sobel=8.43%, delta=+2.84% (t=9.69, p=2.75e-16, W=342.0, wins=98/107). AURG: Hybrid=0.01593 vs Sobel=0.01124, delta=+0.00469 (t=8.79, p=2.96e-14, W=318.0, wins=94/107). Exact match.

checks.name: Single Frozen Evaluation Confirmation
checks.details: Holdout parameters (alpha=0.19, z-score mu/std) were pre-specified in preflight_protocol.json from development set only. run_holdout_evaluation.py executed in a single pass of 42.54s without threshold tuning or iterative re-runs.
